title: Successive lower truncations have a single cohomology sheaf as cone
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category and let $E$ be an object of $D(\mathcal A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] with standard truncations [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category]. For every integer $n$, put $E_n=\tau_{\geq -n}E$ and $E_{n-1}=\tau_{\geq -n+1}E$. Then there is a distinguished triangle [def-weil-triangulated-category] $H^{-n}(E)[n]\longrightarrow E_n\longrightarrow E_{n-1}\longrightarrow H^{-n}(E)[n+1]$, where $H^{-n}(E)[n]$ denotes the complex with $H^{-n}(E)$ in degree $-n$ and zero elsewhere, and the middle map is the canonical transition map of the truncation tower.

source.place: Tag 08D4 proof of part (2), truncation triangle H^{-n}(E)[n] -> E_n -> E_{n-1}

proof.text: Put m=-n, B=τ≥m E, and A=τ<m+1 B. Mathlib TStructure.triangleLTGE_distinguished gives A → B → τ≥m+1 B → A[1]. The generic truncation bounds give A both ≥m and ≤m.

Upstream proved isIso_homologyFunctor_map_truncGEπ_app and isIso_homologyFunctor_map_truncLTι_app identify H^m(A) with H^m(E). These follow from the long homology sequence and vanishing of the adjacent homology of the complementary truncations. Mathlib exists_iso_singleFunctor_obj_of_isGE_of_isLE identifies A with single_m(Y); singleFunctorCompHomologyFunctorIso identifies Y with H^m(A). The singleFunctors shift isomorphism therefore gives H^m(E)[-m] ≅ A.

Mathlib isIso_truncGE_map_truncGEπ_app gives τ≥m+1 E ≅ τ≥m+1 B. Naturality of truncGEπ and the identity π_natTransTruncGEOfLE_app show that transporting the middle arrow along its inverse yields the canonical transition τ≥m E → τ≥m+1 E (use from_truncGE_obj_ext). Transport triangleLTGE along these two object isomorphisms with Triangle.isoMk and isomorphic_distinguished.
